items.title: Port done_prepare metadata-only dirty handling
items.context: done_prepare should allow pre-existing unchanged Lattice story lifecycle metadata dirt, while still blocking source/material dirt, unsafe renames, failed DONE-required evidence, and new files produced by done_prepare.

happy.desc: done_prepare PASSes or reaches later DONE closure checks when the only initial dirty files are unchanged pre-existing Lattice lifecycle metadata for the same story.

edge.desc: done_prepare still blocks at cleanTree for dirty source/material files and for metadata/source rename attempts.

adversarial.desc: failed DONE-required lifecycle metadata remains a DONE closure blocker and cannot be converted into a DONE prepare PASS by the metadata-only allowance.

items.userSees: Running done_prepare with only unchanged pre-existing Lattice lifecycle metadata dirt no longer prints blockedAt: cleanTree; dirty source or unsafe rename scenarios still print blockedAt: cleanTree.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed: same-story pre-existing done-required-evidence metadata remains dirty while done_prepare reports PASS.
Smoke passed: dirty source, metadata-to-source, source-to-metadata, source-to-owner-lease, and other-story metadata scenarios block at cleanTree.
Smoke passed: failed DONE-required lifecycle metadata blocks doneClosure and does not produce DONE prepare PASS.

items.title: Port lifecycle_check advisory done_prepare readiness semantics
items.context: When DONE oracle rows have no blockers, missing done_prepare structured report should be advisory and must not make localReady false.

happy.desc: lifecycle_check target DONE reports localReady true when all DONE oracle rows are clean and the only missing done_prepare report row is advisory.

edge.desc: missing done_prepare report remains blocking when DONE oracle rows contain blockers.

adversarial.desc: the advisory done_prepare row remains visible in the report so hosts still receive the preflight command instead of silently losing guidance.

items.userSees: Running lifecycle_check for a DONE-ready story can print localReady: true while still showing a WARN done.done_prepare advisory row with the next done_prepare command.

items.title: Port regression smokes and benchmark assertions
items.context: Bring over focused smoke coverage for metadata-only dirt, dirty source blockers, unsafe renames, failed done-required evidence, and lifecycle_check localReady semantics.

happy.desc: done_prepare smoke includes a passing metadata-only dirty scenario and lifecycle_check smoke includes a ready fixture with localReady true.

edge.desc: smokes cover dirty source, metadata-to-source rename, source-to-metadata rename, and source-to-owner-lease rename blockers.

adversarial.desc: benchmark assertions fail if metadata-only done_prepare dirt regresses to blockedAt cleanTree or if the scenario precondition is not DONE-closure ready.

items.userSees: The focused smoke and benchmark commands fail loudly if metadata-only dirty DONE readiness regresses to cleanTree blocking.

items.title: Update done_prepare readiness decision documentation
items.context: Document that metadata-only dirty lifecycle evidence is allowed only when unchanged and pre-existing, and that material/source changes still block.

happy.desc: done_prepare automation decision doc states that unchanged pre-existing Lattice lifecycle metadata dirt is allowed for preflight/final cleanTree checks.

edge.desc: the doc also states source/material dirt and unsafe metadata/source renames remain blockers.

adversarial.desc: the doc does not claim done_prepare can waive failed DONE-required evidence or storyFilesHash-related material drift.

items.userSees: The done_prepare decision doc states that unchanged pre-existing lifecycle metadata dirt is allowed, while source/material dirt, unsafe renames, failed evidence, and story-owned drift still block.
